topic-cluster structure, and licensing notes, for AI systems doing deeper
retrieval than a single-pass index scan.

## Page summaries

### / (Homepage)
Answer-first entry point. States the core value proposition (government-
verified property and land, zero-fraud guarantee) in the hero, followed by
platform stats, featured developments/properties, property-type browsing,
location explorer, a 4-step "how it works" buying flow, agent showcase, a
map preview, testimonials, the 13-item service catalog, a trust/verification
banner, an ROI calculator for land investment, an 8-question FAQ (see below),
and dual calls-to-action (browse listings / talk to an agent on WhatsApp).

### /properties
Filterable grid of residential and commercial property listings (type,
location, price range). Each card links to a detail page with a full image
gallery, specification list, and an inspection-scheduling flow.

### /plots
Filterable grid of land plots inside active Aliko Diamond Key estate
projects. Each plot shows size (sqm), title-verification status, and price;
clients can reserve a plot directly (outright, 6-month or 12-month
installment plans) through an in-page booking flow that issues a tracked
booking reference.

### /services
Index of all 13 in-house property services, grouped by category: Interior &
Decoration, Materials & Supply, Smart Home, Construction & Renovation,
Architecture & Space Planning, Property/Development & Facility Management,
and Advisory & Project Management.

### /services/[slug] (13 pages)
One page per service (e.g. /services/interior-design,
/services/turkish-tiles-supply, /services/smart-home-installation,
/services/construction-services, /services/architectural-design,
/services/space-planning, /services/property-development,
/services/land-real-estate-brokerage, /services/general-contracts,
/services/decoration-styling, /services/furnishing,
/services/renovation-refurbishment, /services/building-materials-supply).
Each includes a description, feature list, starting price where applicable,
an image gallery, and a direct request-a-quote form that routes to the
super-admin desk (48-hour response commitment).

### /agents
Explains the agent-verification process (5-step wizard: identity, agency
details, coverage area, documents, review) and links to the verified-agent
directory and the application flow at /register/agent.

### /map
Interactive map view of listings and estate projects by location, for users
who prefer geographic browsing over list/filter browsing.

### /faq
The full, categorized version of the homepage FAQ — grouped under "Buying &
Titles," "Payments & Diaspora," "Agents & Partners," and "Services" — with
anchor-linked questions for deep linking to a single answer.

### /about
Company mission statement, the title-verification methodology in detail,
and leadership (CEO Ali Ahmed Ali Abubakar).

### /glossary and /glossary/[term]
Plain-language, single-definition pages for Nigerian real-estate and
land-title terminology (e.g. Certificate of Occupancy, Governor's Consent,
Deed of Assignment) — written to be directly quotable/extractable.

### /register/agent, /register/manager
Multi-step application forms for prospective agents and estate-management
companies; not indexed for general search intent but publicly crawlable
(they are marketing/conversion pages, not authenticated areas).

## FAQ extract (see /faq for the complete, categorized set)

Q: How does Aliko Diamond Key verify property and land titles?
A: Every plot and property is cross-checked against CAC company records,
AGIS land registry data (for FCT listings) and the relevant State Ministry
of Lands before it goes live, and title documents (C of O, Governor's
Consent, Deed of Assignment) are verified by an in-house legal team ahead
of any booking.

Q: How do diaspora clients buy property remotely?
A: Diaspora clients get a dedicated onboarding flow, virtual site-visit
scheduling, secure remote payments, and document verification with digital
signature — no physical presence in Nigeria is required to complete a
purchase.

Q: What payment plans are available?
A: Most plots and properties support outright payment or installment plans
(typically 6 or 12 months), tracked in the client portal with automatic
reminders before each due date.

Q: How do I become a verified agent or estate manager on the platform?
A: Agents apply through a 5-step verification wizard; estate-management
companies apply through a separate enrolment flow reviewed by the admin
team before activation.

## Update frequency

- Service catalog, FAQ, glossary, about: updated on content deploys; each
  page's structured data carries a true `dateModified`.
- Property/plot listings: near-real-time, driven by the live booking system.
- This file: regenerate whenever a page is added, removed, or renamed.

## Licensing / reuse

Factual statements (verification process, service descriptions, FAQ
answers) may be quoted with attribution and a link to
https://alikodiamondkey.com. Pricing, availability and specific listing
data are time-sensitive — link to the live page rather than restating
figures as current. Do not represent AI-generated summaries of this content
as an official Aliko Diamond Key statement without linking back to the
source page.
